title: app-shell previews/flow-canvas-seeds.spec-parse.test.tsx escapes to the real network (same ECONNRESET mechanism as #4699, different file)
body:
Found while verifying objectui#4699's acceptance criteria (measuring the full `previews/` directory before/after that fix). #4699's own card only scoped `FlowCanvas.test.tsx`; a remainder from a sibling file is a new finding, not that card's.

## Mechanism (same as #4699, different file)

`FlowCanvas` (`packages/app-shell/src/views/metadata-admin/previews/FlowCanvas.tsx`) calls `useFlowNodePalette()` → `useActionDescriptors()` (`useFlowNodePalette.ts`), which fires a real `GET ${apiBase()}/automation/actions` on every mount and aborts it (`AbortController`) on unmount. Under this repo's vitest `dom` project, `fetch` resolves to happy-dom's own polyfill — backed by Node's `http`/`https` core client (`happy-dom/lib/fetch/Fetch.js`: `import HTTP from 'http'`), not undici — so with nothing listening, the abort races a real socket and Node prints an unhandled `Error: socket hang up` / `ECONNRESET`.

`packages/app-shell/src/views/metadata-admin/previews/flow-canvas-seeds.spec-parse.test.tsx` renders `<FlowCanvas>` directly (one `render()` call, in `describe('FlowCanvas one-click revision loop ↔ spec FlowNodeSchema (#3316)')`) and has no `fetch` stub of its own, so it independently exercises the same escape objectui#4699 measured and fixed in `FlowCanvas.test.tsx`.

## Measured (worktree `objectui-issue-4699`, on top of objectui#4699's own fix)

Isolated (`pnpm exec vitest run … --maxWorkers=1`):

- `previews/FlowCanvas.test.tsx` (post-#4699 fix) → **0** `socket hang up` lines (19 → 0, confirms #4699's fix is clean and file-scoped)
- `previews/flow-canvas-seeds.spec-parse.test.tsx` → **1** `socket hang up` line, exit 0, `Tests 25 passed (25)` — the fix does not fail any test, same "harmless noise" character as the rest of this family.

Running the full `previews/` directory (`--maxWorkers=2`, non-isolated) shows exactly 1 residual `socket hang up` line — consistent with this file being the only other one in the directory still triggering the escape (`37 passed (37)` files, `441 passed (441)` tests).

## Suggested direction

Same shape as #4699's own fix (and the #3339/#4105/#4688/#4697 family before it): stub `global.fetch` for the `/api/v1/automation/actions` endpoint in this test file too, degrading with a 404-style response so `useActionDescriptors` falls back to its hardcoded `NODE_PALETTE` — the same behavior already implicitly exercised, just without a real socket. #4699's `FlowCanvas.test.tsx` fix is the direct precedent to copy (a `beforeEach`/`afterEach` pair using `vi.stubGlobal('fetch', …)` / `vi.unstubAllGlobals()`).

## Provenance

Measured in worktree `objectui-issue-4699` (branch `claude/issue-4699-flowcanvas-network-double`) while verifying objectui#4699, on top of that card's own fix.
